name: Umabe Jintarou
source:
The protagonist of the "The Wrong Man - Horse" scenario. An actor. 36 years old. He's had a long career, but has yet to become famous. Until now, he had only played minor roles where he would be killed as soon as he appeared on screen, but this time he was given a major role for the first time. However, he was nervous and he had not been acting well, and he felt even worse due to the crew treated him coldly whenever he made a mistake. Since he had played many roles as characters who die, he's good at acting out falls, and could do some stunts himself. However, he is an extremely bad swimmer who hates even small pools, and has refused any jobs that require him to go into water, which has in turn affected his career's downward slope.
His face and physique are similar to Ushio Masami, but his personality is the complete opposite, as he is kind-hearted and timid. The scar on his right cheek, which looks the same as Ushio's scar, is simply makeup for the role. By happenstance, he is mistaken for Ushio Masami, a former yakuza who looks just like him, and he ends up getting caught up in a commotion involving the yakuza.
He has a sweet tooth and cannot tolerate alcohol or tobacco. His hobby is eating sweets. His special skill is impersonating movie stars. He's a Sagittarius.

[From [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/街_〜運命の交差点〜]Wikipedia[/url]]
